options.name: access_id
options.description: The access ID for authentication.

options.name: access_key
options.description: Access key (relevant only for access-type=access_key)

options.name: access_type
options.description: Authentication method type to be used.

options.name: account_id
options.description: Account id (relevant only for access-type=password where the email address is associated with more than one account).

options.name: admin_email
options.description: Email (relevant only for access-type=password).

options.name: admin_password
options.description: Password (relevant only for access-type=password).

options.name: akeyless_api_url
options.description: URL to the Akeyless API (e.g https://api.akeyless.io)

options.name: akeyless_gateway_url
options.description: Gateway URL relevant only for access-type=k8s/jwt/saml/oidc.

options.name: args
options.description: Optional arguments as key=value pairs or JSON strings, e.g. ['arg1=value1', 'arg2=value2'].

options.name: cert_data
options.description: Certificate data encoded in base64. (relevant only for access-type=cert).

options.name: cloud_id
options.description: The cloud identity (relevant only for access-type=azure_ad,aws_iam,gcp,oci). When not supplied, will be resolved from the cloud environment.

options.name: gcp_audience
options.description: GCP audience to use in signed JWT (relevant only for access-type=gcp).

options.name: host
options.description: Host.

options.name: jwt
options.description: The Json Web Token (relevant only for access-type=jwt/oidc).

options.name: k8s_auth_config_name
options.description: The K8S Auth config name (relevant only for access-type=k8s).

options.name: k8s_service_account_token
options.description: The K8S service account token.

options.name: key_data
options.description: Private key data encoded in base64 (relevant only for access-type=cert).

options.name: ldap_password
options.description: LDAP password (relevant only for access-type=ldap).

options.name: ldap_username
options.description: LDAP username (relevant only for access-type=ldap).

options.name: name
options.description: Secret name.

options.name: oci_auth_type
options.description: The type of the OCI configuration to use (relevant only for access-type=oci).

options.name: oci_group_ocid
options.description: A list of Oracle Cloud IDs groups (relevant only for access-type=oci).

options.name: target
options.description: Target name.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds.

options.name: token
options.description: Temp access token.

options.name: uid_token
options.description: The universal_identity token (relevant only for access-type=universal_identity).

options.name: use_remote_browser
options.description: Returns a link to complete the authentication remotely (relevant only for access-type=saml/oidc).
